source.title: “The Four-Year Cycle Isn’t Dead” — Anthony Scaramucci Predicts the Next Bitcoin Rally
source.description:
Why is Bitcoin still trading around $75K–$80K when Anthony Scaramucci believes it should already be worth $200,000? In this exclusive Cointelegraph interview, the SkyBridge Capital founder explains why Bitcoin is lagging behind its fundamentals, when the next major BTC rally could begin, and why he still believes in the four-year cycle. He also takes aim at Trump's crypto policies, discusses the reported $6.3 billion Binance hack, and reveals what could finally make him give up on Bitcoin.

#Bitcoin #AnthonyScaramucci #BitcoinPrice #Crypto #Cointelegraph
